{{Quote|It's an Ubrikkian star yacht.''"<br />"''Sweet.|[[Tyro Caladian]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="TCotG">''[[Jedi Quest: The Changing of the Guard]]''</ref>}}
'''Ubrikkian Industries''', also known simply as '''Ubrikkian''', was a well-established manufacturer. Its subsidiaries included [[Ubrikkian Private Shipwrights]], [[Ubrikkian Repulsorlift Manufacturing]], [[Ubrikkian Steamworks]], and [[Ubrikkian Transports/Legends|Ubrikkian Transports]]. Ubrikkian Industries itself was a subsidiary of [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]].<ref name="TMA" />
The corporation produced [[Sail barge/Legends|sail barges]], [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]], [[Cloud car/Legends|cloud cars]], [[Swoop/Legends|swoop bikes]] and [[Skiff/Legends|skiffs]]. Ubrikkian was responsible for manufacturing [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] sail barge [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[HAVr A9 Floating Fortress/Legends|HAVr A9 Floating Fortress]]. These ships were usually manufactured at the [[Ubrikkian Yards]].

==History==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the factory had to delay the delivery of its new [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]] that were malfunctioning due to a software bug.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|Droid Madness}}</ref>
